status: author-authorized, known-outcome, retrospective benchmark amendment; not preregistration
known_outcomes: All original v1/v2 and neural v3.1 target evaluation outcomes are already known. This plan is frozen before calculating these new capacity and feedback comparisons, not before access to the benchmark outcomes.

capacity.review_priority: largest source-calibrated expected net saving; stable original sealed position tie break
capacity.mandatory_overflow: unresolved backlog; policy infeasible for completing the full roster at that capacity
capacity.economic_review_rule: source_iso_cap reviews only strictly positive expected net savings, up to the cap; never fills economically needless slots

cost.unresolved_deadline_penalty: illustrative missed-vulnerability cost on unresolved vulnerable functions at the observation deadline; no false-alert cost on unresolved safe functions
cost.units: illustrative scenario units; one reviewed function consumes one analyst slot; neither measured analyst time nor measured monetary/team cost

feedback.batch_rule: greedy consecutive whole commit blocks; recorded-date ties merged before batching; oversized commit/date blocks kept whole
feedback.label_access: only a previously reviewed row may release its benchmark label at the start of service_batch + delay; unreviewed and backlog labels never enter updates
feedback.feedback_cost: review already charged one scenario cost and one slot per reviewed function; no additional free labels or full-label feedback
feedback.source_initializer: existing sealed isotonic knots fitted on the exact 4400 PrimeVul calibration rows only

rolling_update.algorithm: increasing sklearn isotonic regression on sealed source calibration plus the most recent 512 arrived reviewed target rows
rolling_update.update_frequency: start of a batch only after new reviewed labels arrived and eligibility is met
rolling_update.insufficient_feedback: retain the sealed source initializer until eligible; after an eligible fit retain the last fit if a later rolling window is ineligible

feedback.trace_membership: preserve original sealed weighted singleton/review membership at alpha_v=0.10, alpha_s=0.20, clip20; rolling update affects review-queue priority only, not singleton membership or detector weights
feedback.trace_backlog: pool unresolved earlier mandatory review with current mandatory review; service at most the fixed slots per batch by expected-risk priority; no post-run free drain
feedback.source_iso_policy: choose lower calibrated expected-cost automatic label; review only strictly positive expected savings up to fixed slots in current batch; no backlog needed
feedback.arrival_probability_calibration_metric: Brier score using the probability produced when each function first enters its batch, before any label from that batch
feedback.source_chronology: unavailable in prepared and raw PrimeVul lineage; no dated source-before-target claim
feedback.arrival_chronology: analyst review/decision/feedback arrival is simulated even for MegaVul; recorded commit-author dates are ordering evidence only
feedback.transductive_trace_limitation: inherited sealed density-ratio fits use the full unlabeled target project; feedback audit forbids future labels but does not establish an online domain-fitting pipeline
feedback.selection_bias: feedback is conditioned on review selection; rolling calibration is heuristic, potentially biased, and has no claimed target calibration or conformal guarantee

statistics.unit: target project after averaging genuine detector seeds within each project; datasets separate; no seed/function pseudoreplication
statistics.primary_capacity_comparison: source_iso_cap minus msp_cap at capacity0.2, miss10, review0.1, perfect review, completed full-roster cost/function
statistics.primary_feedback_comparison: source_iso_rolling minus source_iso_static at slots16, delay3 batches, miss10, review0.1, perfect review, full-roster cost/function
statistics.reporting: all fixed settings, full rosters, seed-level and seed-averaged project-level outcomes, paired project differences, feasibility/backlog, original class denominators, automatic-label allocations
statistics.interval: descriptive pointwise 95 percent project bootstrap percentile interval of median paired difference, 10000 draws; no confirmatory p-values, population-representative claim, or equivalence claim

stopping: Run all inherited actual detector seeds and all selected projects once under this grid; preserve unsupported-domain fallback, unfavorable comparisons, zero updates, missing-history limitations and infeasible mandatory-review scenarios. Do not choose settings or projects from new target outcomes.
